title: Claim-to-run dependency matrix
status: PROVISIONAL. Scientific gate HOLD. No reruns, no simulations, no tracked-file edits.

evidence_labels.OBSERVED: manuscript text; inventory fields; file existence
evidence_labels.DERIVED: counts from the inventory by predicate (this script)
evidence_labels.INFERRED: mapping of a cited run set to families where the text names no file
evidence_labels.UNKNOWN: runners, shift-null script, r_ab M3 definition

status_vocabulary.SUPPORTED-VERIFIED: all required runs have VERIFIED executed-code identity: 0 records in the inventory, so no claim can carry it
status_vocabulary.SUPPORTED-PARTIAL: all required runs are PARTIAL (commit identified, executed bytes unverified); conditions noted
status_vocabulary.UNSUPPORTED-PROVENANCE: at least one required run is UNKNOWN, or required runs are not on the record for a claim that needs them
status_vocabulary.NOT-ESTABLISHED: no run record located, or the claim has no definition, or its pre-registered criterion is undefined
